m: अनु-√ बाध् Pass. (p -बाध्यमान) to be oppressed or tormented, Rājat.; Kathās.

a: अनुबंध् — {c9c} P. 1 To bind or fasten to, attach, tie, connect; सीमंतं निजमनुबध्नती कराभ्यां Śi. 8. 69 forming, arranging; उभयोरपि राजेंद्र संबंधेनानुबध्यतां (इक्ष्वाकुकुलं) Rām.; सखीजनानुबद्धां कथां Dk. 114 connected with. --2 (a) To have in the train (fig. also); न शिष्याननुबध्नीत Bhāg. (b) To bring about, cause, lead to, result in, produce as a consequence; नानुबध्नाति कुशलं Mb.; हे वृषल ते तथा विक्षेपोऽस्तु यथा हिंसामनुबध्नाति P. VI. 1. 141 com. --3 To press, importune, urge, request; पुनः पुनश्चानुबध्यमाना K. 69, 133, 207, 233. --4 (a) To attend or follow closely, follow at the heels of, follow; को नु खल्वयमनुबध्यमानस्तपस्विनीभ्यामबालसत्त्वो बालः Ś. 7; मधुकरकुलैरनुबध्यमानं K. 139; दिष्ट्या तावदयमनंगो मामिव तमप्यनुबध्नाति K. 158, 194, 319, 347; Ki. 6. 8; Mv. 7. 18; Śi. 5. 26. (b) To chase, pursue; तच्चानुबध्यमानं K. 120; अनुबध्नता तुरगमुखमिथुनं 132. (c) To adhere or stick to, cling to; धन्या चित्रलेखा यामनुबध्नाति देवीप्रसादः K. 221. (d) To continue, take up; तदेवानुबध्यतां तपः 322; तान्येव चिरपरिचितान्यक्षराणि मामनुबध्नंति U. 3 v. l. for अनुरुंधंति; वैशंपायनागमनालापमेवानुबध्य K. 262. (e) To follow, succeed, come close upon; सत्योऽयं जनप्रवादो यद्विपद्विपदं संपत्संपदमनुबध्नातीति K. 73; see अनुबंधि below. --5 To foster, cherish, entertain, harbour; तेषु किं भवतः स्नेहमनुबध्नाति मानसं Mārk. P. --6 To bear, endure; Ks. 49. 47. --7 Not to burst or break loose, hold or keep together; भंगेऽपि हि मृणालानामनुबध्नंति तंतवः H. 1. 95. --pass. To be related to or connected with.

अनुबंधः — 1 Binding or fastening on, connection, attachment, tie (lit. & fig.); यस्यां मनश्चक्षुषोरनुबंधस्तस्यामृद्धिः Māl. 2; एतस्येदृशेन दर्शनेन कीदृशो मे हृदयानुबंधः इति न जानासि U. 3 state of feeling; K. 257. --2 Uninterrupted succession, unbroken sequence, continuous flow, continuity; series, chain; बाष्पं कुरु स्थिरतया विरतानुबंधं Ś. 4. 14; मरण˚ K. 236 following up death, desire for dying; अनुबंधाद्विरमेद्वा K. 280; यदा नात्याक्षीदेवानुबंधं 309 (persistence in) following me, 317; वैर˚, मत्सर˚, Dk. 63, 161; मुच्यतां देवि शोकानुबंधः K. 63 continuous sorrow; दुर्लभजनप्रार्थना˚ Ratn. 1; 4. 16; सानुबंधाः कथं न स्युः संपदो मे निरापदः R. 1. 64 continuous, uninterrupted; परिवृद्धरागमनुबंधसेवया R. 9. 69 continuous enjoyment; अयं सोऽर्थोऽनर्थानुबंधः संवृत्तः V. 5 giving rise to a chain of evils. --3 Descendants, posterity; सानुबंधा हता ह्यसि Rām. --4 Consequence, result (good or bad); आत्मदोषानुबंधेन K. 319 in consequence of; यदग्रे चानुबंधे च सुखं Bg. 18. 39, 25; अनुबंधमजानंतः कर्मणामविचक्षणाः Rām. --5 Intention; design, motive, cause; अनुबंधं परिज्ञाय देशकालौ च तत्त्वतः . सारापंराधौ चालोक्य दंडं दंड्येषु पातयेत् Ms. 8. 126; पाप˚ of evil designs. --6 An adjunct of a thing, a secondary member (मुख्यानुयायि, अप्रधानं); a secondary symptom, symptomatic affection, attendant on the principal disease (वातपित्तादिदोषाणामप्राधान्यं); मूर्छानुबंधा विषमज्वराः Suśr. --7 Connecting link or adjunct of a subject or topic; theme, matter of discussion; introductory reasons; ( विषयप्रयोजनाधिकारिसंबंधः अनुबंधः) (an indispensable element of the Vedānta). --8 (Gram.) An indicatory syllable or letter intended to denote some peculiarity in the inflection, accent &c. of the word to which it is attached; as the ऌ in गमॢ, ण् in इण्; रिपुराप पराभवाय मध्यं प्रकृतिप्रत्यययोरिवानुबंधः Ki. 13. 19. --9 Offence, fault. --10 An obstacle, impediment; also the clog or encumbrance of a family; domestic ties or attachment. --11 A child or pupil who follows the example set by his parent or teacher (मुख्यानुयायी शिशुः). --12 Beginning, commencement. --13 Repeated application or devotion (पौनः पुन्येन अभिनिवेश). --14 Course, pursuit. --15 A small bit or part, a trifle. --16 The junction of a fraction (with an integer), as भागामुबंधपूर्णाकः. --17 Base, stem (प्रकृति). --धी [अनुबध्यते अतिश्वासेन व्याप्रियते अनया] 1 Thirst. --2 Hickup.

अनुबंधिन् — a. (oft. at the end of comp.) 1 (a) Connected with, attached or related to; अहो सरसरमणीयानुबंधिनी स्त्रीजनकथा Māl. 1 having for its contents or subject matter &c.; परिचर्यानुबंधी Dk. 101 continuing. (b) Mixed or blended with; नीलकंठकलकेकानुबंधिना मंद्रहुंकृतेन मामनुमन्यते Māl. 9. --2 Followed by, accompanied with; having in its train, resulting in, having as a consequence; तदियमापत्समंततोऽ नर्थानुबंधिनी Dk. 60; अयमर्थोऽर्थानुबंधी 67; शास्त्रं शास्त्रांतरानुबंधि 156; दुःखं दुःखानुबंधि V. 4 one misfortune closely follows another, or misfortunes never come single; K. 349; Ki. 1. 20; Bg. 15. 2; गुणा गुणानुबंधित्वात्तस्य सप्रसवा इव R. 1. 22 being associated with. --3 Lasting, thriving, prosperous, growing apace, continuous, uninterrupted; अपि त्वदावर्जितवारिसंभृतं प्रवालमासामनुबंधि वीरुधां Ku. 5. 34; ऊर्ध्वं गतं यस्य न चानुबंधि R. 6. 77 continuous, uninterrupted or all-pervading; K. 246, 393.

अनुबंध्य — a. 1 Principal, chief, primary (which may receive an adjunct, as a root, a disease &c.). --2 [वधार्थं बंधः अनुबंधः कर्मणि ण्यत्] To be killed (as a bull), one of the three principal sacrificial animals at the ज्योतिष्टोम sacrifice; गौरनुबंध्यः K. P. 2.

m: अनु-बद्ध mfn. bound to, obliged to, connected with, related to, belonging to
a: अनुबद्ध — p. p. 1 Bound, attached, tied to. --2 Following in the train, coming as a consequence; अनुबद्धार्थानर्थसंशयान् विचार्य Dk. 41. --3 Connected with, related to, relating or belonging to. --4 Constantly sticking to, being in; continued, continuous; नित्यानुबद्धकुलवैरः Ve. 1; ˚मुग्धकाकलीहसितं U. 3; ˚विजृंभकं K. 66; ˚बिंदुभिरश्रुभिः 135 constantly flowing. --5 Fixed upon, directed towards; कलहंस˚ वक्त्रायाः Dk. 33.

m: अनु-बल n. rearguard, an auxiliary army following another.
a: अनुबलं — [अनु पश्चात्स्थितं बलं] A rearguard, an auxiliary army following another.

m: अनु-√ बन्ध् to attach, tie; to bind (by an obligation); to stick, adhere, follow, endure; to be followed by, BhP.

s: strI, (anubaDyate atiniSvAsena vyApriyate'nayA, anu + banDa + karaRe GaY, tato gOrAditvAt NIz .) hikvA । tfzRA । iti medinI ॥ (“anubanDaH SiSO doze pAde muKyAnuyAyini । vinaSvare prakftyAdO pravfttasyAnuvarttane ॥ anubanDI tu hikvAyAM tfzRAyAmapi yoziti” । iti medinI .)
v: strI anubaDyate'tiSvAsena vyApriyate'nayA anu-- banDa--GaY gOrA॰ NIz । hikkAroge, tfzRAyAYca ।

s: puM, (anu + banD + yaTAsamBavaM BAvAdO GaY .) dozotpattiH । prakftyAdiH । AdiSabdena pratyayAgamAdeSAH । vinaSvaraH । uccaritapraDvaMsI itsaMjYako varRaH ॥ muKyAnuyAyiSiSuH । vivAhAmantraRayAtrAdizu muKyaM pitrAdikamanuyAti yaH । muKyAnuyAyI SiSuSceti dvayaM svatantramiti svAmI । prakftasyAnuvarttanaM । prakrAntasya anivarttanaM । ityamaraBaratO ॥ dozotpAde yaTA, -- “anubanDaM budDvAsya daRqo viDIyatAmiti” । vinaSvare yaTA । Ow wakArAnubanDe lopaH ॥ prakftasyAnuvarttane yaTA । BoktumanubanDaH kftaH । SiSO yaTA । “bAlakAnubanDena yAtrABaNgo mABUt” । ityamarawIkAsArasundarI ॥ * ॥ banDaH । iti medinI ॥ AramBaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ leSaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ * ॥ vedAntamate aDikArivizayasambanDaprayojanAni । vEdyakamate vAtAdidozARAmaprADAnyaM ॥
v: pu॰ anu + banDa--yaTAyaTaM BAvAdO GaY । banDane, icCApUrvakadozaviSezAByAse, “anubanDAdikaM dfzwvA sarvaM kAryyaM yaTAkramamiti” smftiH । “anubanDaH pOnaHpunyenABiniveSa” iti raGu॰ । SAstrasyAdO vaktavyezu aDikArivizayaprayojasambanDezu, “anubanDonAmavizayaprayojanADikArisambanDa” iti “asya vedAntaprakaraRatvAttadIyErevAnubanDEstadvattAsidDeriti ca” vedA॰ sA॰ “jYAtArTaM jYAtasambanDaM SrotuM SrotA pravarttate । granTAdO tena vaktavyaH sambanDaH sa prayojana” ityukteH vizayaprayojanAdInAmAramBaprayojakatvAt tadDetutvam । asmin pakze ca anubaDyate aneneti karaRe GaY । muKyAnuyAyini apraDAne, bAlakAdO prakftasyAnuvarttane, saMbanDe, vAtapittAdidozARAmaprADAnye, prakftipratyayAgamAdeSAnAM vikaraRAgamaguRavfdDyAdikAryyaviSezArTamanubanDanIye parinizpannapadakAlezu aSrUyamARatayA naSvare itsaMjYatayA kftalope varRRAdO, “padAniqviqvikaraRAdyanubanDagaRoditam karmmoccAraRamAtreRa spazwamatrAnubanData iti” kavikalpadrumaH । PalasADane punaHpunaranuzWAnAByAse, “anubanDaM parijYAya deSakAlO ca tattvataH । sattvAparADo cAlokya daRqaM daRqyezu pAtayediti” manuH । vanDe'pi mediniH । AramBe, SabdaratnA॰ । anusaraRe “SAntajvaro'pi SoDyaH svAdanubanDaBayAnnara iti suSrutam । santatasambanDe (avicCede) “sAnubanDAH kaTa na syuH sampado me nirApada” iti raGuH । anuvaDyate anuruDyate karmmaRi GaY । paScAdBAvini SuBASume । “anubanDaM kzayaM hiMsAmanapekzya ca pOruzam” iti gItA paScAtsambanDeca । “yadagre cAnubanDe ca suKaM mohunamAtmana” iti gItA ।
m: inseparable adjunct or sign of anything, secondary or symptomatic affection (supervening on the principal disease)
an indicatory letter or syllable attached to roots, &c. (marking some peculiarity in their inflection; e.g. an इ attached to roots, denotes the insertion of a nasal before their final consonant)
a child or pupil who imitates an example set by a parent or preceptor
anything small or little, a part, a small part
(in phil.) an indispensable element of the Vedānta
अनु-बन्धन n. binding, connection, succession, unbroken series.

v: tri॰ anubaGnagAta anu + banDa--Rini । mahacare anugate, anuroDini, vyApake ca । striyAM NIp । “guRA guRAnubanDitvAttasya saprasavA iva” iti ravuH । “aDaSca mUlAnyanusantatAni karmmAnubanDIni manuzyaloke” iti gItA । “sUkzmAnubanDI sUkzmaSca suganDI rocako mfduriti” “medaHkazAyEH Kalu roga eza sudustaro varzagaRAnubanDI” iti ca suSrutam ।
m: having in its train or as a consequence, resulting
अनुबन्धि-त्व n. the state of being accompanied or attended or followed.

v: tri॰ baDArTaM banDo'nubanDaH anu + banDa--karmmaRi RWat । baDArTaM baDye gavAdO । “nAnubanDyAbavA'pi vA । taTodDAraviBAgaSca nEva saMprati varttate” iti smftiH ।
m: अनु-बन्ध्य mfn. principal, primary, liable to receive an adjunct (as a root, a disease) (cf. अनू-बन्ध्य.)
अनु-बिम्ब m. n. reflected image, Naiṣ.
अनु-बि—˚म्बन n. the being a refl˚ im˚, ib.

a: अनुबोधः — 1 An afterthought, recollection. --2 Reviving the scent of faded perfumes, replacing them when removed by bathing.

k.v: स्नानं चर्चा तु चार्चिक्यं स्थासकोऽथ प्रबोधनम्. अनुबोधः पत्रलेखा पत्राङ्गुलिरिमे समे॥

m: अनु-ब्राह्मण n. a work resembling a Brāhmaṇa, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 62
a: अनुब्राह्मणं — A work resembling a Brāhmaṇa (ब्राह्मणसदृशो ग्रंथः P. IV. 2. 62 Sk.).

m: अनु-ब्राह्मणम् ind. according to the Brāhmaṇa, Lāṭy.
अनु-ब्राह्मणिक [Comm. on Lāṭy.], अस्, or अनु-ब्राह्मणिन् [ĀśvŚr.; Vait.], ई, m. a knower of an अनु-ब्राह्मण.

a: अनुब्राह्मणिन्, --क — a. [तदधीते वेद वा इति इनिप्रत्ययः] One who learns or knows an अनुब्राह्मण.

m: अनु-√ ब्रू cl. 2. P. -ब्रवीति to pronounce, recite; to utter; to address, invite (with dat.), ŚBr. &c.; to repeat another's words, learn by heart (by repeating another's words), RV. v, 44, 13; ŚBr.
अनु-√ बुध् to awake; to recollect; to learn (by information) : Caus. -बोधयति, to communicate, to remind, Śāk.
a: अनुबुध् — {c4c} A. To awake, to recollect; learn, obtain information of, know, be aware of; न सत्यमनुबुध्यते K. 104 does not perceive or recognise. --Caus. 1 To remind, put in mind of; अये सम्यगनुबोधितोऽस्मि Ś. 1 well reminded. --2 To advise, inform; इति शिष्येण किलान्वबोधयत् R. 8. 75.
